SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACID, BANK_ID ORDER BY LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) DESC) AS RN,*,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)   AS LatestRecord
    FROM BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST



	  --TAG LATEST RECORDS LNS_GENERALACCTMAST
WITH TEMP_TBL AS (
    SELECT *, LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS LatestRecord
    FROM BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST
),
TEMP_TBL1 AS (
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACID, BANK_ID ORDER BY LatestRecord DESC) AS RN, *
    FROM TEMP_TBL
)
SELECT top 1000 * FROM TEMP_TBL1 WHERE RN = 1 AND ISLATEST = 0 ORDER BY LatestRecord DESC --PB1032623
